svg.title: Wide context map
svg.desc: Language-neutral map from Spain to East Asia, in the same projection and frame as the Mediterranean context map (the frame 0 0 800 537 is 10°W–50°E, 14°N–48°N). Generated from Natural Earth (public domain) 10m land, 50m lakes and 50m rivers. 12°W–127°E, 6°N–63°N. No modern borders and no names.
